functions.name: list_experiment_backlog
functions.description: List open experiment tickets in the team backlog so a new idea can be checked for duplicates or overlap before anything is filed. Returns up to 25 items.

parameters.name: search_terms
parameters.description: Keywords to narrow the list. Omit to return all open items.

functions.name: create_experiment_ticket
functions.description: File a new, structured experiment brief in the backlog. Only use this after checking the backlog and confirming the idea is not already covered.

parameters.name: hypothesis
parameters.description: The hypothesis in "changing X will cause Y" form

parameters.name: target_page
parameters.description: URL or page name the test runs on

parameters.name: primary_metric
parameters.description: The single metric that decides the test

parameters.name: effort
parameters.description: low, medium, or high. Defaults to medium.

parameters.name: inferred_fields
parameters.description: Names of fields the agent inferred rather than received

schema.description: Names of fields the agent inferred rather than received

functions.name: comment_on_experiment
functions.description: Add a new angle or supporting detail to an existing experiment ticket instead of filing a duplicate.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: The new angle or supporting detail

instructions: Tools for triaging experiment ideas against a team's experiment backlog, which lives in GitHub Issues. Check the backlog before filing anything new.
